title: Beatrix and the Bakery
author: Ada Iversen
blurb: Jonah Ravensworth, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
